result.topic_en: Scattered calculations on transformation (characteristic/period) coefficients of theta functions in p variables: the theta series and its period matrix, symbol relations among transformation coefficients, counting formulas involving 2^{p-1}(2^p-1) and expressions r = 2(p-1)(p-3), and a substitution of the variables α, β.
